title: Part I Protheoria: Digression — Lutheran concord not Remonstrant or Pontifical syncretism
pass_a_gloss: Digressio: mutual Tolerantia + fraternal Concord among Protestant churches — do not confuse so-called Lutheran cause with todays Remonstrants (Reformed judgment on their Schism not equal; dogmas already reviewed). Still less compare Augsburg brethren irenic cause with Pontiffs — though Roman Methodistae try to compose both. Hence Remonstrants + Pontiffs long solicit Syncretism, eyeing communion offered Augsburg Confession brethren. Pontiffs via Methodus Richeliana (Gallican Clergy lately revived) Method 1: Missionaries lead into Rom. Communion; specifically Condomiensis now Meldensis Episcopus presses Cap. II Expositionis Catholicae/Tridentinae.
pass_b_english: But in the matter of mutual Tolerance and of fraternal Concord sought among the Churches of Protestants, the cause of those called Lutherans must not be confused — as some would wish — with that of today's Remonstrants, concerning whose Schism the Reformed judgment was not the same, and whose Dogmas were reviewed at length above. Still less is the cause of the Augsburg Brethren, in the irenic business, to be set beside that of the Pontiffs, though today's Roman Methodists may try to compose both. Hence both parties — Remonstrants and Pontiffs alike — have long solicited us toward Syncretism in Religion, with an eye to the communion offered to the brethren of the Augsburg Confession. And the Pontiffs have done so in that Method they call Richelian, which the Gallican Clergy lately revived, as Method 1: leading us by their Missionaries into Communion with the Roman Church. In particular the same Bishop of Condom, now of Meaux, pressed it in Chapter II of his Catholic or Tridentine Exposition.
source_text: Caeterum in materia Tolerantiae mutuae, fraternaeque Concordiae, quaesitae inter Protestantium Ecclesias, non confundenda est (ut vellent) Lutheranorum, qui sic vocantur causa, cum illa hodiernorum Remonstrantium, de quorum Schismate non par Reformatis judicium fuit, & quorum Dogmata prolixe ante recensita. Minus conferenda Augustanorum Fratrum causa, in negotio Irenico, cum Pontificiorum altera, componant licet utramque Methodistae hodierni Romanenses. Unde nos utrique, & Remonstrantes & Pontificii, pridem ad Syncretismum in Religione sollicitarunt, intuitu oblatae communionis fratribus Confessionis Augustanae. Ac fecerunt Pontificii quidem, in ea Methodo quam Richelianam vocant, & quam revocavit nuper Clerus Gallicanus, in Methodo 1. inducendis nobis per Missionarios suos ad Communionem cum Rom. Ecclesia; In specie quoque urfit idem Condomiensis, nunc Meldensis Episcopus, Expositionis Catholicae seu Tridentinae, Cap. II.
